data.question_intent: Requesting clarification on banking NII guidance assumptions and cost of risk outlook
data.question_quote: Can you just give some more colour on the assumption that you've made within your banking NII guidance in relation to the time it will take HIBOR to return to normalised levels?
data.answer_quote: The $42 billion guidance includes market expectations of HIBOR implied above 2% in third quarter. So we've already said that HIBOR at a 1% impacts us by $100 million per month, so if you look overall, our HIBOR expectations as well as the impact of the $100 million - all these are included when you look at our overall confidence in the BNII guidance for the year.
